'''Cell block 923''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell block in the [[Varactyl Vale]] region of the [[Minimum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Two of the inmates incarcerated in cell block 923 were [[Amikab]] and the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ivory]], and the block was overtaken by rioting during the [[invasion of Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cell block 923 is a class-restricted area on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Smuggler class mission "Most Wanted" occurs.<ref name="TOR" />
